decision_titles: Bench in honor of Pam Jones at CVS
plain_text:
WALTHAM DISABILITY SERVICES
COMMISSION
110 Pond Street
Waltham Massachusetts 02451  
                               Minutes of REGULAR Meeting 
October 1, 2026
The Members of the Disabilities Services Commission met in Regular Session on  
October 1, 2026, remotely via ZOOM.  The Chairperson called the remote meeting to order at
8:30.   The roll was called by the DSC Chairperson, Mark Johnson, and the following members
responded as present.       
A roll call of Commission Members for the vote was unanimous, and the Chairperson declared
the motion carried
Present:                                                                                   Absent:                                           
                      
Mark A. Johnson                                                  Robert Marcou
JT Graceffa                                                                   
Jane Demers
Adam Mahar
Joann Stone
MINUTES 
The DSC reviewed the Minutes of October 1, 2026, meeting.
Upon a motion by Joann Stone and second by Adam Mahar it
 was,   
VOTED:    to approve the minutes of October 1, 2026
were accepted as presented.
BUDGET/FINANCES
The Chairperson discussed the current budgets.
DSC WEBSITE
JT will continue to work with the I.T department to assure HP compliance. We will also continue
to keep the Agenda and Minutes up to date.
POLICE DETAILS 
Mark reported receiving 16 HP citations in the previous week. HP Police are using handheld
units now for ticketing purposes and not using paper.
(Discussions)
SIDEWALK PROJECT
Mr. Hanlon from the McDevitt School had a team of students develop a program to identify and
report unstable sidewalk surfaces within the City of Waltham. The DSC would like to invite
students to share their progress and how we as the DSC may be better equipped to confront
these problems service to the community
PAM JONES BENCH LOCATION  
The commission decided to place a bench in honor of Pam Jones, with consensus to locate it
at CVS where it would be most utilized by elderly residents. ( to be approved by Mayor
McCarthy
NORTHEAST SCHOOL Discussion
JT will keep the commission posted on new developments at the Northeast School
UPCOMING PROJECTS/OTHER ISSUES
The DSC is looking for small City (HP) projects to help fund. 
ADJOURNMENT
Upon a motion by Adam Mahar and second by Jane Demers it was,   
VOTED:    to approve the adjournment
SCHEDULING OF NEXT REGULAR MEETING
There being no apparent scheduling conflict with the routine date for the next Regular Meeting,
which will be held remotely on October 1, 2026.   The meeting will begin at 8:30 a.m. via Zoom.
 
The Disability Services Commission does not meet during the months of January and July. 
There being no further business rightly before the Board, upon motion by Adam Maher and
second Bob Marcou was unanimously voted to adjourn. 
A roll call of Commission Members for the vote was unanimous, and the Chairperson declared
the motion carried.  The Chairperson declared the meeting adjourned at  9:32 a.m.               
Documents available at the meeting included the June 5, 2026. Minutes which were available
for the August 7, 2026
 meeting.
